zh: 這位學生的生日在三月。
en: This student's birthday is in March.

zh: 這位學生的座號是 12 號。
en: This student's seat number in class is 12.

zh: 這位學生每天搭公車上學。
en: This student takes the bus to school every day.

zh: 這位學生個性外向。
en: This student is outgoing.

zh: 這位學生個性活潑。
en: This student is lively.

zh: 這位學生個性開朗。
en: This student is cheerful.

zh: 這位學生很喜歡自己的老師。
en: This student really likes their teacher.

zh: 這位學生覺得老師很親切。
en: This student thinks their teacher is kind.

zh: 這位學生很信任自己的老師。
en: This student trusts their teacher a lot.

zh: 這位學生常常問老師問題。
en: This student often asks their teacher questions.

zh: 這位學生很習慣向老師提問。
en: This student is used to asking their teacher questions.

zh: 這位學生很常向老師發問。
en: This student frequently asks their teacher questions.

zh: 做數學練習遇到不會的題目時，這位學生會問老師。
en: When this student comes across a problem they can't solve in math practice, they ask their teacher.

zh: 寫數學題碰到不會寫的題目時，這位學生會向老師提問。
en: When this student runs into a math problem they can't do, they ask their teacher about it.

zh: 數學練習中有題目不會做的時候，這位學生會去問老師。
en: When there is a problem this student can't do in math practice, they go and ask their teacher.

zh: 在這次數學練習中，遇到不會的題目時，這位學生會問老師。
en: In this math practice, when this student comes across a problem they can't solve, they ask their teacher.

zh: 這次寫數學題時，碰到不會寫的題目，這位學生會向老師提問。
en: This time, when this student runs into a math problem they can't do, they ask their teacher about it.

zh: 這一次的數學練習裡，有題目不會做的時候，這位學生會去問老師。
en: In this round of math practice, when there is a problem this student can't do, they go and ask their teacher.

zh: 這位學生個性害羞。
en: This student is shy.

zh: 這位學生個性內向。
en: This student is introverted.

zh: 這位學生個性文靜。
en: This student is quiet by nature.

zh: 這位學生很怕自己的老師。
en: This student is afraid of their teacher.

zh: 這位學生覺得老師很嚴格。
en: This student thinks their teacher is strict.

zh: 這位學生和老師不太熟。
en: This student is not close to their teacher.

zh: 這位學生很少問老師問題。
en: This student rarely asks their teacher questions.

zh: 這位學生不習慣向老師提問。
en: This student is not used to asking their teacher questions.

zh: 這位學生幾乎不向老師發問。
en: This student almost never asks their teacher questions.

zh: 做數學練習遇到不會的題目時，這位學生不會問老師。
en: When this student comes across a problem they can't solve in math practice, they don't ask their teacher.

zh: 寫數學題碰到不會寫的題目時，這位學生不會向老師提問。
en: When this student runs into a math problem they can't do, they don't ask their teacher about it.

zh: 數學練習中有題目不會做的時候，這位學生不會去問老師。
en: When there is a problem this student can't do in math practice, they don't go and ask their teacher.

zh: 在這次數學練習中，遇到不會的題目時，這位學生不會問老師。
en: In this math practice, when this student comes across a problem they can't solve, they don't ask their teacher.

zh: 這次寫數學題時，碰到不會寫的題目，這位學生不會向老師提問。
en: This time, when this student runs into a math problem they can't do, they don't ask their teacher about it.

zh: 這一次的數學練習裡，有題目不會做的時候，這位學生不會去問老師。
en: In this round of math practice, when there is a problem this student can't do, they don't go and ask their teacher.
